description: This is a source file defining the DaysAdapter class for an Android RecyclerView. It fetches and displays daily weather data, manages UI update logic, network requests via Volley, and handles binding data to UI components.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying daily weather data in a list.

classes.name: DayViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to UI elements for a day item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for each day item and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data for a specific position by fetching weather info and updating UI.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the fixed number of items (6).

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Performs a network request to fetch weather info for a given day index and processes the JSON response.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates UI elements of the ViewHolder with fetched weather data.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides loading indicator and displays weather info in the UI.
